title: OPX: a browser-based pedigree editor for clinical genetics
description:
A browser-based pedigree editor for clinical genetics, forked from PhenoTips Open Pedigree. It draws pedigrees following the NSGC standardized nomenclature, reads and writes Invitae/Progeny XML, PED, GEDCOM, BOADICEA/CanRisk and GA4GH FHIR, computes cascade-testing risks and Wright's inbreeding coefficient, and exports colour or black-and-white PDFs. Data never leave the user's computer unless exported.

Based on Open Pedigree by Gene42 Inc. o/a PhenoTips (LGPL-2.1).
